candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Rotation-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the body hover, nozzle retraction and pupil glances are the intentional translations. The body hovers at rest with an explicit measured gap. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof.
note: glTF axes: +Y up, character faces -Z; anatomical left is -X (wrench arm). Root at the floor origin under the body centre.
